title: Gemini Skills vs Gems: Google Is Retiring Gems, Here’s Your Timeline
key_facts: Google announced on 30 Sep 2026 that Gems are being replaced by Skills
Skills reusable inside any regular Gemini chat
Google will automatically recreate existing Gems as Skills
Personal accounts: Skills arrived 30 Sep, Gems convert in November 2026
Workspace business and enterprise: no earlier than 1 Mar 2027
Attachments, sharing and cross-surface sync are gaps
Available to free users, 18 and older for now
No published evidence that Skills give better answers than Gems
quote_evidence: On September 30, 2026, Google announced that Gemini Gems, the custom assistants you build inside the Gemini web app at gemini.google.com, are being replaced by a new feature called Skills.
Google says it will automatically recreate your existing Gems as Skills.
It is not a smarter model.
why_it_matters_hint: Gems are folded into Skills on a staged schedule; the main risk is lost attachments and sharing.
notes: Google announced on 30 Sep 2026; this article (6 Oct) is a timeline explainer drawn from Google documents and Android Authority. Score lowered by 1 (5 to 4).
